public_rationale: The September 2023 egg example meets the stated occurrence rule. Ars verified a false GPT-based answer on Quora. Futurism then documented its appearance in Google's generative search, extending the chain beyond an ordinary search snippet. The antecedent and a later circulation event are therefore documented. The sources subsequently corrected their answers, but correction does not erase the transfer. This supports the broad reading about fabricated information circulating; it does not establish circulation of Marcus's particular poisonous recipe or show that every fabrication spreads.
limitations: The result depends on the broad reading of 'stuff up like that'.
The transfer is documented by firsthand news investigations rather than internal system logs.
The originating Quora feature was labeled ChatGPT, but Ars identified its model as text-davinci-003.
The receiving system was Google's experimental generative search.
The precise day of the generative-search test is not stated; September 2023 is the supported event precision.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that fabricated information from an LLM will be taken up and repeated as factual by another LLM-based system.
The surrounding discussion includes search engines, so circulation through a public webpage into generative search qualifies.
I read 'stuff up like that' as fabricated information or advice generally, rather than exclusively the particular poisonous recipe.
One verified occurrence establishes the predicted phenomenon. It does not establish that every fabrication circulates, or that circulation is widespread.
A conventional search snippet alone does not establish transfer into another LLM; the receiving system must also be generative.
criteria.support_condition: After publication, a documented case traces false information generated by one LLM through an identifiable source into another LLM-based system's factual output.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event establishes that the predicted circulation cannot occur under the stated scope. Failed transfers or the absence of examples over a finite period do not contradict an undated forecast.
